Sanitiser.description: Configuration of Sanitiser users and members sanitisers

Enable.description: Whether to enable sanitization of Umbraco members

DomainsToExclude.description: A comma separated list of domains to exclude from sanitization. Members with email addresses on those domains are excluded. Leave empty to have all members sanitized.

Mode.description: Delete removes members after replacing their personal data; Anonymise replaces their personal data but keeps the records.

MaxRecords.description: Maximum number of members to load and process in a single run, to bound memory on very large sites. 0 (default) means no limit; when exceeded, the first MaxRecords are processed and a warning is logged.

AnonymiseCustomProperties.description: In Anonymise mode, also clear editor-defined member properties (address, phone, ...), which often hold personal data. Built-in membership status fields (approved, locked out, login tracking) are left intact. Default true. Ignored in Delete mode.

PropertiesToPreserve.description: Property aliases to leave untouched when AnonymiseCustomProperties clears member properties, e.g. a non-personal flag you rely on. Matched case-insensitively.

Enable.description: Whether to enable sanitization of Umbraco backoffice users

DomainsToExclude.description: A comma separated list of domains to exclude from sanitization. Users with email addresses on those domains are excluded. Leave empty to have all users except the Super Admin sanitized.

Mode.description: Delete removes users after replacing their personal data; Anonymise replaces their personal data but keeps the records.

MaxRecords.description: Maximum number of users to load and process in a single run, to bound memory on very large sites. 0 (default) means no limit; when exceeded, the first MaxRecords are processed and a warning is logged.
